description.describe_ch: This course covers the fundamental concepts and applications of electric/electronic circuits for electrical and computer engineers as well as for engineers who need to gain a broad understanding of this field. The course starts with basic concepts, including charge, current, voltage, and resistive circuits. Essential concepts, devices, theorems, and dc circuits, first-order circuits, and ac circuits will be discussed subsequently. Also discussed are basic electronic components including diodes and transistors and their primary applications.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Submit homework on time. Do not plagiarize others' work. If you do not understand something, ask your classmates, teaching assistant, or teacher for help.
2. Do not cheat on any exams (including quizzes, midterms, and finals). If you are caught cheating, you will be dealt with according to school regulations.
3. Pay attention in class. Do not sleep, play with your phone, or chat with your classmates.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
The quizzes take 60% of the total grades. No make-up test for quizzes.
The homework takes 10% of the total grades. Late homework will not be accepted.
No cheating for all tests, including quizzes, midterm examination and final examination.
No late for every class.
Try to support your classmates.
Follow every instructions which the lecturers give.
